prompt: I just spent an hour tracking down why our Postgres connection pool kept maxing out under load — turns out we had a leaked connection in a retry path that only fired on timeout. We fixed it by switching to pgbouncer instead of just bumping max_connections, since bumping the limit would've just delayed the same problem. Can you note this down so we don't lose the reasoning?

assertions.text: chron (the CLI) was actually invoked to create the note, not a hand-written markdown file bypassing it
The created note has type: decision in its frontmatter
The note body specifically mentions the leaked connection in the retry path as the root cause
The note body specifically mentions pgbouncer and the rationale for choosing it over raising max_connections
The note is not a vague placeholder (e.g. 'Fixed a Postgres bug') — it captures the actual reasoning from the prompt
